author.name: Display name.
model.name: Display name.
model.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Minimum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
model.reasoningMaxTokens.maximum: Maximum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
model.tokenizerFamily: Tokenizer family used for local input estimates.
deployment.id: Canonical deployment ID. An explicit sort on this field must be final and ascending.
deployment.reasoningMaxTokens.minimum: Minimum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
deployment.reasoningMaxTokens.maximum: Maximum configurable reasoning budget, when defined.
deployment.capabilities.pdfInput: PDF input in the underlying deployment.
deployment.dataHandling.endToEndEncrypte: Catalog declares end-to-end encryption to this deployment.
deployment.dataHandling.retentionDays: Maximum disclosed retention of stored prompts and responses, in days; null means unknown.
deployment.dataHandling.trainingUse: Whether data may be used for training.
deployment.dataHandling.zeroDataRetentio: No persistent retention of prompts and responses.
deployment.dataHandling.teeVerified: Catalog marks the TEE as verified.
deployment.upstream.gpuCount: Disclosed GPU count; an unspecified zero is treated as missing.
provider.name: Display name.
provider.credentialModes: Catalog-supported credential modes. Does not describe this key's assigned credential.
request.model: Model or deployment selector supplied by the caller, before resolving to a catalog ID.
request.time: UTC request start time, held constant while evaluating every candidate and condition.
request.bodyBytes: Exact incoming JSON body size in bytes, including whitespace and request controls, before redaction.
